title: Goldman Sachs 10-K Level 3 Assets
goal: Using SEC EDGAR, open The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.'s annual report on Form 10-K for fiscal year 2017. In that filing, find the line item "Total level 3 financial assets" and report its value for each of these periods: as of December 2017 and as of December 2016. Report numbers exactly as printed (keep the filing's units; use negative numbers for values shown in parentheses). If you cannot find the filing or the line item, set found=false and do not guess.

found.description: false if the filing or the line item could not be found

units.description: units as printed in the filing, e.g. 'in millions'

filing_url.description: URL of the 10-K document the values came from

output.notes: The 'Total level 3 financial assets' row on page 118 of The Goldman Sachs Group, Inc.'s fiscal 2017 Form 10-K prints 19,201 for December 2017 and 23,280 for December 2016.
